frame_capture.method: Exact decoded displayed-frame indices; no fps resampling/nearest-frame replacement

observations: Exact 0.0–2.5s frames show approved terrain/coastline, Seoul/Korea focus, progressively drawn route and aircraft; single Seoul place label is retained after the duplicate-hook repair.
Exact 3.0–5.5s frames show Tokyo destination, source-backed remaining 556 km at its actual route phase, Japan emphasis and arrival; no decorative slogan or subtitle.
Exact 6.0–7.5s frames show Taipei preview, explicit ASSUMPTION and ASSUMED HOLD state; route barrier is a meaningful response, not a camera-only event.
Exact 8.0–10.0s frames show reroute and a second connection; the moving aircraft stay individually visible and the primary routes are stronger than faint context.
Exact 10.0–10.5s frames show the approved geographic handoff into cached Earth; geography is not hidden by a full-frame blur/fog overlay.
Exact 11.0–11.9667s frames retain visible East Asia terrain, atmosphere, city lights and final Shanghai connection; the four approved Earth city labels are unchanged, not newly redesigned.
